source.name: OPAP corporate: Sports Sponsorships
source.quote: For the tenth consecutive season, Pame Stoixima is the Grand Sponsor of Panathinaikos BC Actor
source.note: OPAP/Allwyn's sponsorship page: 9th then 10th consecutive season as Grand Sponsor. The pame stoixima logo sits large on the front of the 2026/27 home jersey, below the number - visible in the club's kit-launch photos (paobc.gr, 13 Sep 2026), the official shop product photos (paoshop.gr) and 24 Sep 2026 game photos vs Paris.

source.name: Panathinaikos BC: kit launch, 'Panathinaikos BC AKTOR and adidas unveil the new home jersey for the 2026/27 season'
source.quote: Panathinaikos BC AKTOR and adidas present the new home jersey for the team for the 2026/27 season
source.note: The bp Helios logo is on the lower front of the left leg of the shorts in the launch's hero photo and in the 24 Sep 2026 game photo vs Paris (both paobc.gr). BP is listed as a Main Partner on the club's partners page (paobc.gr/en/partners).

source.name: AKTOR Group press release: expansion of cooperation with KAE Panathinaikos - AKTOR
source.quote: ανανέωσε τη χορηγία ονοματοδοσίας και, ταυτόχρονα, παρέδωσε στην ομάδα ένα γήπεδο
source.note: Naming sponsorship renewed for three more seasons, until 2028-29: the team plays as Panathinaikos AKTOR / Panathinaikos AKTOR Athens (team name on the EuroLeague site; club partners page lists AKTOR as Naming Partner). The AKTOR wordmark is not visible on the front of the 2026/27 home jersey, the shorts or the back (see summary - no back photo found).

summary: Pame Stoixima (OPAP's betting brand, Grand Sponsor of the club for a tenth straight season) is on the front of the jersey below the number; bp is on the lower left leg of the shorts; AKTOR is the naming partner (team name Panathinaikos AKTOR). The left chest and right leg of the shorts carry the EuroLeague badge with the Etihad wordmark - the competition's own badge, not counted as a sponsor, same as on other EuroLeague kits. adidas is the kit maker (20+ years). Not complete: no photo of the back of the 2026/27 home jersey could be found (kit-launch and shop photos show only the front, game photos likewise), so any sponsor above or below the back number is unverified. The club's partners page (paobc.gr/en/partners) also lists Cosmote/TELEKOM, Coca-Cola 3E, Altion, Globalsat, Red Bull, ZeniTH, Tesla, Uber, ECOMMBX (renewed 29 Sep 2026), IEK AKMI, Metropolitan College, HEDNO, Hygeia, Hans & Gretel, Molon Lave, RRD and Ostracon, none of which appear on the kit in any photo found.
